name: Portugal (Kingdom, 1830–1910)

colors.symbolism: the traditional blue of the House of Braganza

description: A field divided vertically blue and white, charged with the crowned royal arms of Portugal on the dividing line.
history: The blue-and-white of the constitutional Kingdom of Portugal, flown from 1830 until the republican revolution of 5 October 1910 replaced it with green and red. Blue and white remain beloved as the historic Portuguese colours.
